source: Configuration of tools/content/checks/story_wiring.mjs (docs/design/alternate_history.md, SL-28, SL-29, SL-30). `enforce` lists the owners whose findings stop the build; every other owner's findings are reported in docs/design/validation/story_wiring_report.json and on the console. The lead flips the check to strict when the other story slices have landed by setting `enforceAll` to true (or by adding their owner names to `enforce`). `allowance` lists flags that are read before their owner sets them, with that owner; an allowed flag that is now set is reported as stale so the row can be removed.
